svg.title: Figure 3 | Three Kinds of Evidence Answer Different Questions
svg.desc: Each layer needs its own tests and observations. A functional pass does not establish usability or improved outcomes. Vertical positions compare evidence; they do not claim an improvement has occurred.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 3 | Three Kinds of Evidence Answer Different Questions
Does the feature follow its rules?
Can users understand, operate and complete the task?
Have errors, waiting or work costs actually decreased?
Each layer needs its own tests and observations. A functional pass does not
establish usability or improved outcomes. Vertical positions compare
evidence; they do not claim an improvement has occurred.
